ruleDefinitions.name: Local Password status lookup Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Linux passwd command with -S or -s flags, which reveal the password status of local accounts. Attackers may use this command to enumerate account status, identify locked or active accounts, and prepare for privilege escalation or persistence activities.

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND platform:"Unix"
AND process_name:"passwd"
AND (process_command_line:" -S " OR process_command_line:" -s ")
AND NOT parent_process_name:("puppet","chef","ansible","salt","cloud-init")
